rules.claim: The API router registers ShareLinkViewSet under share_links, and the viewset includes CreateModelMixin, so its collection create route is the source-visible creation entry.
ShareLinkViewSet uses PassUserMixin and IsAuthenticated, identifying request.user as the relevant caller principal for serializer and permission processing.
ShareLinkViewSet declares IsAuthenticated as an endpoint permission class.
ShareLinkViewSet also declares PaperlessObjectPermissions; its inherited create semantics must be examined rather than assuming document-object authorization.
The serializer's document field resolves the submitted document and passes that exact document object into validate_document(document).
ShareLinkSerializer.validate_document first requires the caller to have global documents.view_document permission.
The same conjunctive validation additionally calls has_perms_owner_aware(user, 'view_document', document) on the exact resolved document.
If document validation passes, create assigns a random slug and delegates to inherited serializer creation for the ShareLink.
If the serializer's conjunctive user/global-view/owner-aware exact-document test does not pass, validate_document raises PermissionDenied('Insufficient permissions.').
Implementation path requiring owner-aware view_document on the exact serializer-resolved document proceeds toward creation.
Implementation denies creation when the exact-document permission validation fails.
